question_text:
120. Triangle

Given a triangle array, return the minimum path sum from top to bottom.

For each step, you may move to an adjacent number of the row below. More formally, if you are on index i on the current row, you may move to either index i or index i + 1 on the next row.
output_format: Integer representing the minimum path sum.
explanation: Dynamic Programming approach (bottom-up). Start from the second-to-last row and update each cell to be its value plus the minimum of the two cells directly below it. The top cell will eventually contain the minimum path sum.
